title: Attach custom domains to unified web CloudFront distributions
description:
Route 53 alias records: chattic.us (prod), staging.chattic.us, dev.chattic.us -> the unified web CloudFront distribution (same origin serves UI and /api/*).

Single ACM cert per hostname (or SAN cert). No api.chattic.us subdomain.

Verify: HTTPS, Next.js loads, POST /api/channels/... works, GET /api/turns/{id}/stream SSE reconnect with Last-Event-ID through the /api path.

Update cloud_environments.py fallbacks and acceptance workflow secrets to site-url not separate API URL.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text: Route 53 alias records are in the web stack CDK. They apply automatically once ChatticusDns is delegated and web stacks deploy. No separate task work beyond deploy + verify SSE through `https://dev.chattic.us/api/turns/{id}/stream`.
